items.title: 2 Big Trump Breakthroughs Can Power Stock Markets Higher
items.summary: President Donald Trump has woken up on the right side of bed to start the week–and so has the stock market.  Two potential breakthroughs, instigated by the Trump administration, are being cheered by Wall Street.  First, the president said he may be open to meeting his Iranian counterpart Masoud Pezeshkian at the U.N. General Assembly this week.
